Manifest.Name: Tinkerer Chance
Manifest.Author: Local
Manifest.Description: Replaces the Tinkerer perk's fixed 20% chance to keep an upgrade material with a percentage you choose. Press F4 in game to open the settings window: drag the slider to set 0-100%, and rebind the hotkey from the same window. Also applies to ScavToolUpgrade's tool upgrades, which roll their own 20% instead of using the vanilla method. Both settings are remembered between sessions.
